title: haplopappus spinulosus subsp. laevis
intro: Haplopappus spinulosus subsp. laevis, commonly known as Smooth Haplopappus, is a plant species in the daisy family, characterized by its smooth leaves and stems. The health benefits of Smooth Haplopappus include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and anti-bacterial properties. Its therapeutic actions include soothing digestive tract irritations, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing, all of which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, primarily sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Smooth Haplopappus, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
